title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.17007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users. In long-horizon tasks, subgoals, available inputs, and environmental states change as execution progresses. Agents must select currently applicable skills from an expanding skill pool and prepare candidates for subsequent steps.   We propose Skill Adapter, which enables personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills. The system distills local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback and stores them as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills. The routing agent selects general-purpose skills and applicable Adapters based on the current subtask, execution progress, and environmental feedback, incrementally maintaining a task-level online skill

translated_title: Skill Adapter：通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体利用外部技能来复用任务流程与工具使用经验。通用技能描述的是共享的执行流程，而具体的工具选择、操作方式和输出要求则因用户而异。在长程任务中，子目标、可用输入和环境状态会随执行进程不断变化，智能体需要从不断扩展的技能池中选出当前适用的技能，并为后续步骤准备候选技能。我们提出了Skill Adapter，实现通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由。该系统从用户需求和执行反馈中提炼局部调整，并将其存储为与通用技能相关联的Adapter。路由智能体根据当前子任务、执行进度和环境反馈，选择通用技能及适用的Adapter，并增量式地维护任务级在线技能库。
tldr: 提出Skill Adapter系统，将从用户需求和执行反馈中提炼的个性化调整存储为与通用技能关联的Adapter，并通过路由智能体依据子任务、执行进度和环境反馈实现在线技能选择，从而达成通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Skill Adapter, which stores personalized adjustments distilled from user requirements and execution feedback as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills, and uses a routing agent to select applicable skills and Adapters online based on subtasks, execution progress, and environmental feedback, enabling personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills.
